text.title: The most perfect believer in terms of his faith is the one who has the most excellent manners, and the best of you are those who are best to their womenfolk
text.text: Abu Hurayrah (may Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah’s peace and blessings be upon him) said: "The most perfect believer in terms of his faith is the one who has the most excellent manners, and the best of you are those who are best to their womenfolk."
text.explanation:
The Prophet (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him) informs that the most perfect people in terms of their faith are those who possess excellent manners, have cheerful faces, do good, speak kind words, and refrain from hurting others.

And that the best believers are those who are kindest to their womenfolk - their wives, daughters, sisters, and other female relatives - for they are among the worthiest of good treatment.
text.benefits:
The Hadīth points out the merit of good manners and that they are part of faith.
Good deeds are part of faith, and faith increases and decreases.
Islam honors women and encourages kindness to them.
text.attribution: [Narrated by Abu Dāwūd, At-Tirmidhi, and Ahmad]

arabic.title: أكمل المؤمنين إيمانا أحسنهم خلقا، وخيركم خيركم لنسائهم
arabic.text: عن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: «أَكْمَلُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ إِيمَانًا أَحْسَنُهُمْ خُلُقًا، وَخَيْرُكُمْ خَيْرُكُمْ لِنِسَائِهِمْ».
arabic.explanation:
يُخْبِرُ النبيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أنَّ أَكْمَلَ الناس إيمانًا مَن حَسُنَ خُلُقُه، وذلك بطَلَاقَةِ الوجه، وبذل المعروف، وحسن الكلام، وكف الأذى.


وخَيْرَ المؤمنين خيرُهم لنسائِهِ، كزَوجتِه وبَناتِه وأخواتِه وقَريباتِه؛ لأنهن مِن أحقِّ الناس بحُسْنِ الخُلُق.
arabic.benefits:
فضيلة الأخلاق الحسنة وأنها من الإيمان.
 العمل من الإيمان، والإيمان يزيد وينقص.
إكرام الإسلام للمرأة والترغيب في الإحسان إليها.
